title: Prayer to St. Anthony for Lost Things
text:
St. Anthony, perfect imitator of Jesus,
who received from God the special power
of restoring lost things,
grant that I may find what I have lost.
More importantly, help me to find and possess God,
the ultimate good,
rather than the goods of this world.

Restore to me, above all,
the grace of God and peace of mind and heart,
which sin has taken away.
Help me earnestly to seek the Kingdom of God
and his justice before all else.
Confident in your powerful intercession,
I will recover what I have lost
and will enjoy the good things
of earth and heaven.
Amen.

translation.latin:
Sancte Antoni, perfecte imitator Iesu,
qui a Deo specialem potestatem
restituendi res perditas accepisti,
concede ut inveniam quod perdidi.
Potius adiuva me invenire et possidere Deum,
bonum ultimum,
potius quam bona huius mundi.

Restitue mihi, super omnia,
gratiam Dei et pacem mentis et cordis,
quam peccatum abstulit.
Adiuva me sincere quaerere Regnum Dei
et iustitiam eius ante omnia.
Confisus in tua potenti intercessione,
recuperabo quod perdidi
et fruar bonis
terrae et caeli.
Amen.

attribution: Traditional Prayer to St. Anthony of Padua
notes: St. Anthony of Padua (1195-1231) is one of the most beloved saints, famous for finding lost objects but also for his powerful preaching and miracles. This prayer asks not only for help finding material things but, more importantly, for spiritual restoration and the grace of God.
